guides.title: 光路溫度漂移補償：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Optical-path thermal-drift compensation: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 漂移補償必須考慮感測雜訊及控制穩定度。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Drift compensation includes sensor noise and loop stability. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：漂移補償必須考慮感測雜訊及控制穩定度。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：對照開迴路漂移及閉迴路殘差。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Drift compensation includes sensor noise and loop stability. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Compare open-loop drift with closed-loop residuals. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「對照開迴路漂移及閉迴路殘差」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare open-loop drift with closed-loop residuals, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光路溫度漂移補償：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Optical-path thermal-drift compensation: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「受控量定義：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。功率、共振波長與相位不是同一受控量，鎖功率可能鎖在錯誤光譜位置。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Controlled quantity: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Power, resonance wavelength and phase differ; a power lock can select the wrong spectral point. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜受控量定義：模型與設計：在頻譜上標出工作點和誤差信號零點，列出可能的多解。
觀察站 2｜控制延遲：模型與設計：把延遲加入頻率模型，記錄階躍超越與振盪。
觀察站 3｜重新校準：量測與判別：建立版本化校正與安全回復設定，以未參與擬合的負載驗證。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Controlled quantity: model and design: Mark operating point and error-signal zeros and list ambiguous solutions.
Observation station 2 | Control delay: model and design: Include delay in the frequency model and record overshoot/oscillation.
Observation station 3 | Recalibration: measurement and diagnosis: Version calibration and fallback settings; validate on an unfitted load pattern.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「控制延遲：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「重新校準：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Control delay: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Recalibration: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：誤差為零一定代表雷射和光路正常。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：誤差為零一定代表雷射和光路正常。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Zero error proves the source and path are healthy. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Zero error proves the source and path are healthy. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

history.textEn: Ansys describes multichannel thermal interactions in photonic circuits. The course uses this context to examine saturation, crosstalk and calibration rather than one tuning slope.
